title: Elevated Cat Feeder Stand With Transparent Bowl
bullets: 15-degree tilted, elevated design raises the bowl off the floor
Transparent bowl made of food-grade material
Bowl and base come apart for easy cleaning
Built from ABS, PC, and plastic
Suitable for dogs, cats, puppies, and other small animals
description: Keep your pet's food and water in one place with this elevated feeder stand. The stand tilts at 15 degrees in an elevated design. The transparent bowl is made of food-grade material. The stand is built from ABS, PC, and plastic. The bowl and base come apart, and the set is washable, portable, and easy to clean. It suits dogs, cats, puppies, and other small animals. Each order includes one base stand and one or two bowls, depending on the version. Packed in a plastic bag for shipping. Shipping comes from a US warehouse. If you are a pet parent who wants a raised feeder, this one is worth a look. The stand is not easy to overturn. Keep the bowl and base clean between meals, and wipe down the stand as needed. A transparent bowl lets you check the food level at a glance.

faq.q: Does it come with one bowl or two?
faq.a: It includes one base stand and either one or two bowls, depending on the version.
The bowl and base come apart, and the set is washable, portable, and easy to clean.
Estimated 3–7 business days to the US, plus processing 1–3 days. These are estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates.
